s: Python, Node.js, Java, Go, Rust — pick your weapon
d: Pick ONE language and master it deeply before learning others. Each has strengths: Python for simplicity and data, Node.js for async I/O, Java/C# for enterprise, Go for performance and concurrency, Rust for safety. Your language choice matters less than your depth of understanding.

p: Backend logic is written in server-side programming languages. Languages differ by typing (static vs dynamic), execution (compiled vs interpreted), and concurrency models (threads vs event loops).
1. Node.js (JS): Async event loop, great for I/O bound tasks.
2. Go: Goroutines, compiled, great for microservices.
3. Java: JVM, heavily object-oriented, enterprise standard.
4. Python: Highly readable, immense data science ecosystem.

// Node.js Express Example
app.get('/api/users', async (req, res) => {
  const users = await db.query('SELECT * FROM users');
  res.json(users);
});

Interpreted (Python/JS): Code -> Interpreter -> CPU
Compiled (Go/Rust): Code -> Compiler -> Binary -> CPU
Bytecode (Java/C#): Code -> Compiler -> Bytecode -> Virtual Machine -> CPU
